title: Ineffective! Waste of Money!
text: Ineffective! Waste of Money!. I bought these cups via their original crowdfunding campaign. Please heed my warning: These cups are awful. They absolutely will not make you think you’re drinking flavored water. I also tried both the orange and the apple. Awful. Ineffective. Waste of money. You will see lots of similar opinions over at the crowdfunding comments page.

product_metadata.title: Scent Flavored Grape cup - The cure for boring water!
features: The Right Cup creates the perception that your water is lightly fruit flavored with a hint of sweet by using the power of aroma, and a sweet rim without introducing any additives to the water. It’s not Magic. It’s CRAZY GOOD SCIENCE!
Few tips: HAVE PATIENCE, this is the most important tip | Drink from the cup 5 times a day for a few weeks in order to get used to it | Touch the rim with your lips to get the sweetness sensation.
A unique, and surprising gifting option for your friends and family for many social occasions like Birthdays, Christmas, Back to School.
Care instruction: Store the cup upside down to retain the scent | Rinse before first use| Avoid extreme heat as it accelerates the release of the aroma.
